description: This Java class `SensorLiveGraph` provides a graphical component for visualizing real-time sensor data within a UI panel. It manages sensor data acquisition, dynamic graph rendering, and user interactions such as configuring sensors and scaling options.

classes.name: SensorLiveGraph
classes.description: A Swing JPanel component that plots live sensor data, with configurable refresh rate, sensor selection, and scaling options.

methods.name: SensorLiveGraph
methods.description: Constructor initializing the sensor graph with configuration, default sensor, and extra menu item.

methods.name: createRunnable
methods.description: Creates a background runnable thread to periodically fetch sensor data and trigger repaint.

methods.name: grabNewValue
methods.description: Fetches the latest sensor value and updates the graph data.

methods.name: showPopupMenu
methods.description: Displays context menu for sensor and scale configuration.

methods.name: addChangePeriodItems
methods.description: Adds menu items to change the data refresh period.

methods.name: addChangeSensorItems
methods.description: Adds menu items to select different sensors.

methods.name: setSensor
methods.description: Sets the current sensor and clears the data buffer.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a new sensor reading to the data buffer, maintaining maximum size.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Custom painting method to render the sensor data graph and labels.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Calculates the range of values to display based on auto-scaling or fixed scale.

methods.name: paintLastValue
methods.description: Draws the latest sensor value at the center of the graph.

methods.name: paintGraph
methods.description: Draws the data points and lines representing sensor readings.
